title: Distortion Veil
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium game VFX concept sheet for a Minecraft Cobblemon community world-boss encounter. Create one polished landscape art-direction sheet titled "DISTORTION VEIL", with a large hero view on the left and two clearly separated detail panels on the right labelled "MODEL AURA" and "PARTICLE GROUND". Add small footer text "CONCEPT ART • NOT AN IN-GAME SCREENSHOT". Subject: Giratina in its recognizable Altered Form, grey segmented body, gold head armour, six legs and broad black wings with red spikes, standing at the centre of a spacious Minecraft arena. Retain a convincing Minecraft/Cobblemon creature and block-built terrain aesthetic, with premium flowing VFX, rather than painting the creature as a realistic animal. Boundary design: a large spherical encounter volume suggested by sparse flowing violet mist filaments, broken crimson arcs and drifting motes. An open, breathing spectral veil, with most of the sphere left transparent; irregular long ribbons drift across different heights and softly fade instead of forming a solid cage. Body aura: narrow charcoal-violet wisps hug the outline of Giratina's wings, shoulders and feet, with a thin crimson rim and a few upward ghost embers; the aura follows the body's contours and never obscures its face or silhouette. Ground: smooth broken particle paths and low drifting fog currents; organically incomplete traces with soft tails, never a manufactured disc. Hero viewpoint: player eye-height, several small distant Minecraft player silhouettes for scale; Giratina stays clearly visible with abundant open combat space. Detail panels show how the body-following aura and particle-only ground tracing look at close range. Palette: charcoal, deep violet, selective crimson and subtle cool lavender highlights, with Giratina's gold preserved. Premium restrained lighting and clear material detail, readable in dusk light; balanced contrast, credible game VFX rather than opaque cinematic smoke. Strictly avoid solid ground clocks, voxel ground rings, metal orbital bands, crown emblems, UI health bars, HUDs and dense particle confetti. This is an exploratory visual direction, not an implementation guarantee.

title: Rift Cathedral
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: refined landscape concept sheet for an impressive Minecraft Cobblemon world-boss bubble. Title "RIFT CATHEDRAL". Large hero scene on the left, two stacked right-hand detail panels labelled "MODEL AURA" and "PARTICLE GROUND". Footer exactly "CONCEPT ART • NOT AN IN-GAME SCREENSHOT". Show Giratina Altered Form faithfully recognizable: grey segmented body, gold head armour, six legs and black wings with scarlet spikes, rendered as a high-quality Cobblemon model on a Minecraft arena, with a few tiny Minecraft players for scale. Main visual idea: six tall, narrow, irregular vertical spatial rifts spaced far apart around the encounter boundary, with indigo-black interiors and fine luminous violet/crimson edges. Sparse high arcs of drifting spectral particles suggest an immense cathedral-like vaulted bubble over the arena; these arches are entirely luminous air, no stone architecture, no columns made from blocks and no cage. Negative space is the primary design feature: players can see clearly between the rifts and directly toward the boss. Giratina's aura: a restrained double-exposure trail of dark wing-shaped vapour close behind its existing wings, with violet tips and scarlet sparks slipping along the body; model-following, elegant, ominous, never another full creature silhouette. Ground accent: slow bands of falling motes dissolve into short, curved, softly drawn particle trails near each rift; a few thin wandering luminous traces surround the boss's feet without making a solid rotating circle. The right-hand details must show the distinctive rift-edge texture, body aura, and smooth particle traces. Lighting: dramatic indigo dusk, restrained violet-white light, dark red accents; preserve gold highlights on the boss, detailed terrain, readable body shading. Composition should feel monumental and premium, but plausible as a game VFX art direction. Avoid metallic rings, solid flat ground dials, gears, clocks, crown badges, opaque dome surfaces, HUDs, excessive bloom and particle clutter. Distinctive tall vertical boundary, not a uniform fog sphere.

title: Astral Tempest
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: beautiful professional landscape VFX direction sheet for a seasonal Minecraft Cobblemon world boss. Title "ASTRAL TEMPEST". One large left hero view and two smaller right detail panels labelled "MODEL AURA" and "PARTICLE GROUND". Footer "CONCEPT ART • NOT AN IN-GAME SCREENSHOT". Recognizable Giratina Altered Form at centre: grey segmented body, gold head armour, six legs, black wings with red spikes; retain the voxel/Cobblemon aesthetic and block-built Minecraft arena. Design direction: an airy, enormous sphere implied by moving-looking streams of tiny stars and sweeping comet trails in deep indigo, silver blue and restrained violet. Four broad but translucent auroral currents flow around the encounter volume at different inclinations; their edges dissolve into individual particles and negative space rather than forming rigid hoops. No solid cage, no metallic rings. Keep most of the view transparent and the boss readable. Giratina aura: a close-fitting blue-violet spectral sheath with drifting silver sparks along its silhouette, a restrained scarlet heart-light at the chest, and a low ghost wake near its feet. Do not repaint the Pokémon or hide its features. Ground effect: a loose spiral of smooth, fleeting particle brushstrokes that fades between strokes, with star motes briefly tracing outward paths; no disc, no continuous solid ring, no clock symbols or geometry built from blocks. Show particle tails and depth with high-quality controlled VFX rendering. Player-eye-height hero shot with a few distant Minecraft players for scale, darker evening arena, high material definition, elegant rather than chaotic. This direction should feel adaptable to future seasonal bosses through its colours and movement language. Avoid screen-filling bloom, opaque smoke, mechanical dials, ornate gold machinery, UI elements and unreadable busy particles.

title: Giratina Aura Studies
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium landscape game VFX exploration sheet titled "GIRATINA • AURA STUDIES". Three equally sized panels, same full-body pose, camera scale and neutral dusk Minecraft arena background in each, with the same recognizable Cobblemon-style Giratina Altered Form: grey segmented body, gold head armour, six legs, black wings with red spikes. Carefully maintain the creature's silhouette and body material details across all three. Panel one title "UMBRA MANTLE": charcoal-violet vapour clinging closely to the wings, shoulders and legs, narrow crimson edge-light and slow upward shadow embers. Panel two title "RIFTFIRE CROWN": a few curling crimson-gold energy tongues rising from behind the shoulders and head like an atmospheric crown, with luminous filaments following the wings and short ember trails near the feet; absolutely no physical crown object or ring emblem. Panel three title "ASTRAL SHEATH": cool indigo and silver-blue scintillation following the model's contours, delicate wisps and sparse stars slipping backward from the wing tips, tiny scarlet accents retained near the chest. In every panel, aura is body-following atmospheric VFX at varied depth, not a separate spherical bubble, never an opaque cloud, never covering the face. Include a small silhouette thumbnail or close crop of wing-edge aura in each panel to communicate silhouette readability. Ground in all panels only has scattered airborne motes and very soft wisps, no circles or dials. Restrained premium particle rendering, soft translucent falloff, plausible game VFX, detailed textured creature surfaces, no Minecraft-block aura geometry. Footer "CONCEPT ART • NOT AN IN-GAME SCREENSHOT". Keep typography clean and professional, no HUD or health bars, no extraneous text.
